At RedRooster Technologies, we’ve been experimenting with something lately that I’m pretty excited about; a small agentic coding assistant that runs directly in the terminal called. Right now we are calling it, LANA Code, and it’s running on a 24GB MacBook Pro using a Qwen 2.5 coding model (13B) and currently we are using it against a mobile project.

And honestly, it’s working better than we expected!
Hackers hijacked an active AI coding assistant session to trick a developer into downloading a poisoned PyPI package. The Shai-Hulud worm then spread across about 100 internal repositories.
